notes: Every stage file is now fetched from a URL that carries the rev (?v=53), so a build can never be served half-old. raw.githubusercontent sits behind a CDN with a five-minute TTL keyed by path, which meant a push took up to five minutes to be visible and, worse, could hand a new loader an old copy of one file. Keying the URL on REV makes a bump a new cache key on every edge, so a new build lands immediately and can never mix with the previous one. The rev-52 focus fix rides along.
